facts.fact: Direct cash transfer of food subsidy under NFSA was first started in the UTs of Chandigarh and Puducherry from September 2015
facts.quote: Direct Cash Transfer in food was started in UTs of Chandigarh and Puducherry from the month of September, 2015 and part of Dadra & Nagar Haveli from March, 2016.

facts.fact: It was then started in part of Dadra & Nagar Haveli from March 2016
